smyx-elderly-gait-instability-detection-analysis 1.0.3 changelog:

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect new details and requirements.
- Bumped version metadata (from 1.0.4 to 1.0.6) in documentation.
- Removed obsolete or duplicate documentation file: skill-card.md.
- Minor script or utility adjustments in skills/smyx_common/scripts/util.py.

- Updated internal configuration in scripts/config.py.
- No changes to user-facing features or documentation.

- Major update: The skill’s user identity (open-id) handling is now fully automated and invisible to the user.
- End users are no longer prompted or required to input any identity information; internal identity management is handled by the script.
- All history report queries are forced to use the cloud API—reading from local memory or manual aggregation is strictly prohibited.
- Documentation has been significantly restructured and condensed, with clearer workflow and usage sections.
- API usage and parameter handling have been updated for greater consistency and security.

- Initial release of smyx-elderly-gait-instability-detection-analysis.
- Uses AI pose estimation on videos to analyze elderly gait parameters (step length, gait speed, trunk sway, cadence).
- Outputs fall risk level (low/medium/high) based on detected gait abnormalities.
- Supports scheduled or automatic monitoring, generates alerts/reports for medium/high risk levels.
- Strict privacy controls and open-id verification required for all operations.
- Designed for integration with smart cameras and health-management platforms for elderly care.
